RecorderManager.onPause(function listener)

Listen to the recording pause event. In this case, the recorder enters the recording pause state, which can be triggered only by RecorderManager.pause()(Minimum version: 23.9.0).

Parameter

function listener

Listening function for recording pause events

Sample Code

Page({
    onload() {
        recorderManager.onPause(() => {
            ma.showToast({
                title: 'onPause',
                icon: 'success',
                duration: 500
            });
        });
    }
})
